commits.summary: Record the L01–L20 setup jobs' results and queue four follow-ups (verification pending)
commits.body:
Merges the collected results of the eight setup jobs for the merged Java PR links L01–L20 brief and records them in llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-l01-l20-brief-setup.md. Six passed: L10 Calcite, L16 Guava, L19 Kafka and L20 JSqlParser as intended (L10 and L19's landed tests fail on the parent, so 15 cases now show their regression separating the sides; L20's landed test does not compile on the parent and a copy without its six fix-only assertions has 16 failures there); L05 JUnit built both sides and passes there, but the fix's tests do not compile on the parent because the fixture uses constants the fix renames; and the L09 rdf4j job passed without running its compliance classes, since compliance/sparql runs them under failsafe in verify and the job stopped at package (the record says so instead of counting them). Two failed in their build set-up: L14 Iceberg because gradle-git-properties (JGit) finds no repository in a linked worktree, so its checkouts are now standalone depth-1 clones (checked inline: :generateGitProperties passes offline); L15 Gradle because org.openmbee.junit:junit-xml-parser:1.0.0 is gone from the Plugin Portal, so an init script adds repo.gradle.org/gradle/public, which the upstream build-logic itself declares, for that group only (the jar's sha256 matches both pins' verification-metadata.xml).

Jobs queued with this commit: 20261125-165654-setup-build-iceberg-api-core-data-parque (L14 on clones), 20261125-165654-setup-build-gradle-distributions-at-both (L15 with the init script), 20261125-165913-setup-run-rdf4j-1989-s-landed-compliance (L09 compliance classes under failsafe, each step failing if a named class did not run), 20261125-170100-setup-run-junit-6104-s-landed-nested-cla (L05: the fix's tests on the parent with only four constant references mapped to the parent's names or equal string values).
